question:
Identify the option that rectifies the underlined spelling error in the given sentence.

The boys of our class have reported that considerable progress in the __implimentation __of their policies has been made.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Implementation**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The correct spelling of the word is 'implementation'**. **(कार्यान्वयन)**
 
• The error in the given sentence is the incorrect spelling of the word 'implementation'.
 
• The correct spelling can be remembered by breaking down the word into 'implement' and 'ation'.
 
• 'Implement' means to put into effect or carry out, while '-ation' is a suffix used to form nouns from verbs.
 
• Therefore, 'implementation' means the act of putting a plan or idea into action.
 
 
• Example: The implementation of the new plan is important.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
